title: The biggest
summary: Say what is the biggest, oldest, best or most famous with the superlative: أَكْبَرُ مَدِينَة (the biggest city), أَفْضَلُ رِحْلَة (the best trip), مِنْ أَجْمَلِ الْأَمَاكِن (one of the most beautiful places).
intro: From the Citadel hill Yusuf shows his friends all of Amman. The comparative you learnt yesterday also means 'the most': put it in front of a noun with no الـ, and أَكْبَرُ مِنْ (bigger than) becomes أَكْبَرُ مَدِينَة (the biggest city). Before a plural with الـ it means 'the …-est of': مِنْ أَكْبَرِ الْمَسَارِح (one of the biggest theatres). The form is the same for masculine and feminine nouns.
objectives: Say 'the biggest …' with the superlative + a noun: أَكْبَرُ مَدِينَة
Say 'one of the most …' with مِنْ + superlative + a plural: مِنْ أَجْمَلِ الْأَمَاكِن
Use أَفْضَلُ (the best), أَقْدَمُ (the oldest) and أَشْهَرُ (the most famous)
Describe a view and famous places in Jordan

realLife.title: Sunset on the Citadel hill
realLife.story: In the late afternoon Yusuf drives his friends up to the Citadel, the oldest part of Amman. Between Roman columns and an Umayyad palace they look down on the Roman Theatre, argue about the best place in Jordan, and wait for the sun to set over the hills.

sentences.en: Amman is the biggest city in Jordan.
sentences.literal: Amman (is the) biggest (of a) city in Jordan

mistakes.why: After the superlative a singular noun has no al-: akbaru madīna.

sentences.en: This is the oldest place in Amman.
sentences.literal: this (is the) oldest place in Amman

sentences.ar: الْبَحْر الْمَيِّت أَخْفَضُ مَكَان فِي الْعَالَم.
sentences.en: The Dead Sea is the lowest place in the world.
sentences.literal: the sea the dead (is the) lowest place in the world

sentences.en: Petra is the most famous place in Jordan.
sentences.literal: Petra (is the) most famous place in Jordan

mistakes.why: Before a noun the superlative never takes al-: ashharu makān.

sentences.en: This is the best trip of my life.
sentences.literal: this (is the) best trip in my life

sentences.ar: هُوَ مِنْ أَكْبَرِ الْمَسَارِح فِي الْأُرْدُنّ.
sentences.en: It is one of the biggest theatres in Jordan.
sentences.literal: it (is) of the biggest (of) the theatres in Jordan

dialogue.title: On the Citadel hill
dialogue.culture: People have lived on Amman's Citadel hill for thousands of years: there are Roman columns from the Temple of Hercules and an Umayyad palace from the 8th century. Below it lies the Roman Theatre, which is still used for concerts. Amman is said to be built on seven hills, جِبَال, but today the city covers many more.

lines.ar: وَصَلْنَا! هٰذَا جَبَلُ الْقَلْعَة، وَهُوَ مِنْ أَعْلَى الْجِبَال فِي عَمَّان. مِنْ هُنَا تَرَوْنَ الْمَدِينَة كُلَّهَا.
lines.en: Here we are! This is the Citadel hill, one of the highest hills in Amman. From here you can see the whole city.

lines.ar: يَا سَلَام! مَا أَجْمَلَ هٰذَا الْمَنْظَر! هَلْ عَمَّان أَكْبَرُ مَدِينَة فِي الْأُرْدُنّ؟
lines.en: Wow! What a beautiful view! Is Amman the biggest city in Jordan?

lines.ar: نَعَم، هِيَ الْعَاصِمَة وَأَكْبَرُ مَدِينَة فِي الْأُرْدُنّ. وَهٰذَا الْجَبَل أَقْدَمُ مَكَان فِيهَا: عُمْرُهُ آلَافُ السِّنِين.
lines.en: Yes, it's the capital and the biggest city in Jordan. And this hill is the oldest place in it: it is thousands of years old.

lines.ar: وَمَا هٰذِهِ الْأَعْمِدَة الطَّوِيلَة هُنَاكَ؟ هِيَ أَطْوَلُ أَعْمِدَة رَأَيْتُهَا فِي حَيَاتِي!
lines.en: And what are those tall columns over there? They're the tallest columns I've ever seen in my life!

lines.ar: هٰذَا مَعْبَدُ هِرَقْل مِنْ أَيَّامِ الرُّومَان. وَهُنَاكَ أَيْضًا قَصْر أُمَوِيّ، وَهُوَ أَحْدَثُ مِنَ الْمَعْبَد.
lines.en: That's the Temple of Hercules, from Roman times. And there's also an Umayyad palace, which is newer than the temple.

lines.ar: وَمَا ذٰلِكَ الْمَسْرَح الْكَبِير تَحْتَنَا، فِي وَسَطِ الْبَلَد؟ هَلْ هُوَ رُومَانِيّ أَيْضًا؟
lines.en: And what's that big theatre below us, in the city centre? Is it Roman too?

lines.ar: نَعَم، هُوَ الْمُدَرَّج الرُّومَانِيّ. هُوَ مِنْ أَكْبَرِ الْمَسَارِح الْقَدِيمَة فِي الْأُرْدُنّ، وَفِيهِ مَقَاعِد لِسِتَّةِ آلَافِ شَخْص.
lines.en: Yes, it's the Roman Theatre. It's one of the biggest ancient theatres in Jordan, and it has seats for six thousand people.

lines.ar: سِتَّةُ آلَاف! هٰذَا أَكْبَرُ مِنْ قَاعَةِ مَدْرَسَتِنَا بِكَثِير. يَا يُوسُف، مَا أَفْضَلُ مَكَان فِي الْأُرْدُنّ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
lines.en: Six thousand! That's much bigger than the hall at our school. Yusuf, what's the best place in Jordan, in your opinion?

lines.ar: سُؤَال صَعْب! الْبَتْرَاء أَشْهَرُ مَكَان، وَهِيَ مِنْ عَجَائِبِ الدُّنْيَا السَّبْع. لٰكِنْ فِي رَأْيِي، وَادِي رَم أَجْمَلُ مَكَان.
lines.en: A difficult question! Petra is the most famous place, and it's one of the Seven Wonders of the World. But in my opinion, Wadi Rum is the most beautiful place.
segs: Wadi (valley): part of 'Wadi Rum', a desert in Jordan

lines.ar: وَالْبَحْر الْمَيِّت؟ فِي كِتَابِي هُوَ أَخْفَضُ مَكَان عَلَى الْأَرْض، أَلَيْسَ كَذٰلِكَ؟
lines.en: And the Dead Sea? My book says it's the lowest place on earth, isn't that right?

lines.ar: صَحِيح، هُوَ أَخْفَضُ مَكَان فِي الْعَالَم، وَمَاؤُهُ أَكْثَرُ مُلُوحَةً مِنْ أَيِّ بَحْر آخَر. فِيهِ تَطْفُو مِثْلَ الْخَشَب!
lines.en: That's right, it's the lowest place in the world, and its water is saltier than any other sea. You float in it like a piece of wood!

lines.ar: هٰذِهِ أَفْضَلُ رِحْلَة فِي حَيَاتِي! لٰكِنْ عِنْدَنَا وَقْت قَلِيل. يَوْمَ السَّبْت نُسَافِرُ إِلَى الْبَتْرَاء، أَلَيْسَ كَذٰلِكَ؟
lines.en: This is the best trip of my life! But we don't have much time. On Saturday we're going to Petra, aren't we?

lines.ar: نَعَم، بَعْدَ الْغَدَاء نُغَادِرُ عَمَّان، فَالطَّرِيق إِلَى الْبَتْرَاء طَوِيل. وَالْآنَ تَعَالَوْا! أَجْمَلُ وَقْت هُنَا هُوَ وَقْتُ الْغُرُوب.
lines.en: Yes, we leave Amman after lunch, because the road to Petra is long. And now come on! The most beautiful time here is sunset.

lines.ar: اُنْظُرُوا إِلَى الشَّمْس فَوْقَ الْجِبَال! هٰذِهِ أَجْمَلُ صُورَة فِي هَاتِفِي، وَسَأُرْسِلُهَا لِسَامِي الْآنَ.
lines.en: Look at the sun over the hills! This is the most beautiful photo on my phone, and I'm going to send it to Sami right now.

reading.title: The Citadel and the theatre
reading.ar: زَارَ دَانْيَال وَلَيْلَى جَبَلَ الْقَلْعَة مَعَ يُوسُف. هُوَ مِنْ أَعْلَى الْجِبَال فِي عَمَّان، وَأَقْدَمُ مَكَان فِي الْمَدِينَة. مِنْ هُنَاكَ شَاهَدُوا الْمُدَرَّج الرُّومَانِيّ، وَهُوَ مِنْ أَكْبَرِ الْمَسَارِح فِي الْأُرْدُنّ. فِي رَأْيِ يُوسُف، وَادِي رَم أَجْمَلُ مَكَان فِي الْأُرْدُنّ.
reading.en: Daniel and Layla visited the Citadel hill with Yusuf. It is one of the highest hills in Amman, and the oldest place in the city. From there they saw the Roman Theatre, one of the biggest theatres in Jordan. In Yusuf's opinion, Wadi Rum is the most beautiful place in Jordan.
segs: Wadi (valley): part of 'Wadi Rum', a desert in Jordan

quiz.prompt: What is the oldest place in Amman?
How many people can sit in the Roman Theatre?

it is the lowest place in the world

quiz.prompt: Which word has qāf (ق), the deep k from the back of the throat?

completion: Excellent! You can talk about the biggest, the oldest, the best and the most famous, and say 'one of the most beautiful'. Next time: a day in Petra.
